question: What powers of distant hearing and immobilizing bonds arise from this practice?
premises: Knowledge of hearing from afar is named
Paralysis of bonds is named likewise
These are presented as resulting attainments
inference: The practice yields knowledge of distant hearing and the power to paralyze bonds
uncertainties: pāśa-stobha may mean paralysis of fetters or paralysis by fetters
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of hearing from afar and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
